split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before execution sidecar, expected exit code, diagnostic stage, live runtime dispatch metadata, or fixture basename
split_policy.positive_rule: execution metadata can cite positive behavior only through e2e compile-link-run sidecars after parser, sema, lowering, IR, or runtime owners claim their phase evidence
split_policy.provenance_rule: README rows, fixture basenames, meta sidecars, expected exit codes, runtime dispatch symbols, native compile args, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, and migration-only rows are provenance until a canonical hand-authored behavior owner claims behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: legacy-looking, old-mode, retired-route-looking, gate-looking, compatibility-looking, unsupported-feature, strict-dispatch, unresolved-symbol, non-fast-path, generated-only, evidence-log, and migration-only metadata are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
